title: Linear Regression and Regularization
body:
Suppose we are trying to fit a linear model $$\hat{Y}=\mathbb{X}	heta.$$ Assume that our design matrix $$\mathbb{X}$$ contains $$n$$ rows and $$p$$ + $$1$$ columns, the first of which contains the value $$1$$ for each observation.

Let $$	ilde{\mathbb{X}}$$ be the mean-centered version of $$\mathbb{X}$$ (that is, each column except the intercept column is scaled to have a mean of 0), and let $$	ilde{Y}=[	ilde{y}_1 	ilde{y}_2 dotdotdot 	ilde{y}_n]$$ be the mean-centered version of Y, our true response vector. Assume that $$p$$ $$ \geq $$ $$5$$.

In the first few subparts of this question, we will explore the models that result from un-regularized linear regression, depending on whether or not we center our data.
